title: Option+Cmd+K "Send to Claude Code" does not work
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude Code WebStorm extension does not copy and paste current selection line range by Option+Command+K. It just open up a new Claude Code terminal each time the key combination is pressed.

Tried:
1. uninstall and reinstall the extension
2. restart IDE
3. start terminal and Claude Code manually
4. There is no hot key conflict. Alt+Cmd key combination is only used by Claude Code command "Send to Claude Code".

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: webstorm
- Version: 1.0.6
- Feedback ID: 

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: Cannot submit feedback because custom data retention settings are enabled\n    at NB5 (file:///Users/nate.liu/.nvm/versions/node/v22.14.0/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:1876:1168)\n    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:105:5)\n    at async Promise.all (index 0)\n    at async file:///Users/nate.liu/.nvm/versions/node/v22.14.0/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:1862:19563","timestamp":"2025-05-30T04:15:28.010Z"}]
```
author: ghost

top_comments.author: hackyon-anthropic
top_comments.body:
Thanks for the report! Taking a look at this now.

In the meantime, can you please also update Claude Code? 

We had a similar issue with Claude Code when the version is below 1.0.4 (use `claude --version` to check)

top_comments.author: hackyon-anthropic
top_comments.body:
Can you please also check to see if your plugin is at version 0.1.6-beta (from within the IDE `Settings > Plugins`)? 

Also, we've seen (in rare cases) where there are multiple versions of the Claude Code plugin installed, which may also cause this issue.

Thanks!

top_comments.author: ghost
top_comments.body:
Thanks for the prompt response! 👍 
Here's the version info

```bash
claude --version
1.0.6 (Claude Code)
```
